title: A Proven Way to Quit Masturbation in 7 Days
article4_intro_desc: Masturbation has become one of the most common and widespread problems nowadays, and the reason is simple: people's lack of full awareness in using technology correctly and safely, which may lead to exposure to pornographic content and consequently to masturbation. After finishing reading this article, you will be able to completely stop masturbation and it will never be a problem for you again. Let's get started.
article4_topic1: Strong Psychological Preparation (You Are in Control)
article4_topic2: The Amazing Benefits of Lowering the Gaze
article4_topic3: Proper Thinking and Cleansing the Mind of Pornography
article4_topic4: Loneliness and How It Is the Main Cause of Pornography
article4_topic8: Practicing Masturbation Without Harm if Unable to Stop
article4_sec1_title: 1- Strong Psychological Preparation (You Are in Control)
article4_sec1_desc: The first and most important point is to understand that you are the one in control, not a person trapped in the cycle of pornography and masturbation unable to escape. You must completely change this idea, because the truth is that you can leave this cycle any time you choose, simply.
article4_sec1b_desc: The core idea here is to reprogram your thinking that you are in control of yourself, and that you are not a slave to this habit. When you truly believe this, it builds self-confidence within you and makes you psychologically stronger and more capable of stopping at any time without feeling helpless.
article4_sec2_title: 2- The Amazing Benefits of Lowering the Gaze
article4_sec2_desc: Before understanding why lowering the gaze is one of the strongest ways to stay away from pornography and masturbation, we must understand that the brain is greatly affected by what we see.
article4_sec2a_desc: Humans rely heavily on visual stimulation, meaning that anything you see affects your emotions and behavior. For example: a natural landscape makes you calm and relaxed, while a scene of a fight makes you tense and upset. Similarly, when a person looks at the opposite sex in an arousing way, it creates stimulation in the brain that can turn into sexual desire. This is where lowering the gaze comes in, as it prevents this stimulation from the start.
article4_sec2b_desc: And with becoming accustomed to lowering the gaze everywhere (street, phone, television), the brain begins to reduce its response to these stimuli, and desire becomes calmer and more natural. This ultimately helps reduce pornography and masturbation gradually and effectively 👍.
article4_sec3_title: 3- Proper Thinking and Cleansing the Mind of Pornography
article4_sec3_desc: Your way of thinking determines your entire life. A successful and a failed person may have the same capabilities, but the real difference lies in the way of thinking. When you change your thinking for the better, your life changes for the better. Optimism and thinking positively of God play a huge role in this. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Be optimistic about good, you will find it,' which confirms the importance of positive thinking. Also, in the sacred hadith, Allah Almighty said: 'I am as My servant thinks of Me,' meaning that your positive thinking about God has a great impact on your life and outcomes.
article4_sec3a_desc: To stop pornography and masturbation, you must first believe that you are capable of controlling yourself and that you are not a slave to this habit. Repeating the idea that you are able to change strengthens your willpower and self-confidence. And with preventing sexual thoughts, content, and fantasies, plus lowering the gaze, stimuli gradually decrease, desire weakens, and this helps you build stronger control over yourself and your life in general.
article4_sec4_title: 4- Loneliness and How It Is the Main Cause of Pornography
article4_sec4_desc: One of the most important things to understand is that the mind is weaker in the face of pornographic thoughts when you are alone and isolated, because loneliness gives greater space for thinking and fantasies. That's why it's very important to break the cycle of isolation and always be close to people or in a place with movement and sound, even if you don't speak to them directly. What matters is that you are not alone all the time.
article4_sec4a_desc: Also, one of the strongest methods is to always keep yourself busy, because the mind cannot focus on two things at the same time. If negative thoughts or pornographic thoughts come to you, immediately get up and change your situation: study, move around, sit with your family, or do any simple activity. After a few minutes, you will find the thoughts starting to disappear because you occupied your mind with something else.
article4_sec4b_desc: As it is said: 'If you do not occupy yourself with the truth, falsehood will occupy you.' This means that idleness is a primary reason for the return of these thoughts, while being busy breaks them quickly and returns your focus to your natural state.
article4_sec5_desc: Here we talk about the organic impact of pornography and masturbation, and how Kegel exercises can help reduce the impact of sexual stimuli. Kegel exercises target the pelvic muscles and help improve control over this area and strengthen physical control in general.
kegel_note_desc: You can search for how to practice Kegel exercises correctly on YouTube or the internet, and you will find detailed explanations that help you apply them properly and benefit from them in the best way.
article4_sec5a_desc: Simply put, with excessive masturbation, there may be an unbalanced increase in blood flow to the genital areas, while regularly practicing these exercises helps improve blood circulation and strengthen muscles, thus improving control and reducing excessive arousal. Therefore, it is recommended to practice Kegel exercises daily (twice a day, for example, at the beginning), and after a while, you can gradually reduce them according to ability. They are among the physical habits that can significantly support the recovery journey over time.
article4_sec6_desc: Diet has a very significant impact on physical and mental state, and consequently on hormonal balance and sexual appetite. That's why it's important to take care of your food and make it as healthy as possible, such as eating vegetables daily, drinking enough water, and eating beneficial sources like eggs and meat. At the same time, you must reduce processed and unhealthy foods like chips, crackers, and sodas, because they can cause lethargy, mood swings, and affect body and hormone balance.
article4_sec6a_desc: Among the tips that might help reduce desire indirectly: eating garlic in moderation, as it is said to help reduce excessive blood flow to the genital areas, and also paying attention to foods beneficial for digestion like apples, apple cider, and olive oil. As for bread, it is preferable to consume it in moderation, 2-3 loaves daily according to the body's needs, because excess may cause digestive problems, but at the same time, it is not preferable to completely eliminate it. The basic idea is that a balanced diet helps stabilize the body and hormones, thus reducing negative effects on mental and sexual health.
article4_sec7_desc: One of the methods that helps reduce masturbation is to avoid looking at the genitals, especially during the period of stopping masturbation. The idea is that the brain associates looking at these areas with increased stimulation and desire. Over time, if you prevent yourself from looking at them in daily situations like the bathroom or during cleaning, you start to break this association gradually, and thus the arousal associated with this sight reduces significantly. It is also important that after finishing your need in the bathroom, you wash and leave quickly without focusing or thinking about these areas, so as not to give an opportunity for any mental association to form.
article4_sec7a_desc: On the other hand, we must understand that the bigger problem often comes from pornography itself, not just from masturbation, because watching pornographic content is what causes addiction, distracts thinking, and causes mood swings and lack of concentration. In the case of stopping pornography and reducing stimuli, control becomes easier and symptoms are much less.
article4_sec8_desc: The correct way to practice masturbation is when you feel high or increased desire, then you practice it but without watching any pornographic videos or relying on sexual fantasies and thoughts. The idea here is to only practice masturbation when desire reaches a high level, for the purpose of releasing or reducing it. Over time, you will notice that your mind gets used to this method, so that it is not affected by any inappropriate scenes as used to happen.
article4_sec8a_desc: Studies have proven that separating the mind from relying on scenes or fantasies during masturbation helps reduce its negative impact, and makes the practice linked only to physical need when desire is high, whether due to a long period of abstinence or for any other reasons. This advice is considered one of the strongest methods: try to practice masturbation without porn or sexual fantasies if you cannot stop it completely. But if you are able to stop, then of course it is better not to practice it at all.
article4_sec9_desc: Quitting masturbation brings you great benefits on the psychological and physical levels, and helps you regain your balance and focus and live more comfortably and stably. Over time, you will notice an improvement in mood, increased self-confidence, higher activity and vitality, and a better ability to focus and achieve your goals.
article4_benefit1: 1- A more natural life and psychological comfort without constant preoccupation with pornography.
article4_benefit2: 2- Improved mood, increased self-confidence, and self-satisfaction.
article4_benefit3: 3- Increased activity and vitality as a result of body balance and stability.
article4_benefit4: 4- Greater ability to focus, achieve goals, and succeed in life.
article4_benefit5: 5- A feeling of psychological comfort and closeness to God by leaving harmful habits.
article4_benefit6: 6- Building a better life and achieving ambitions gradually and clearly.
article4_summary_title: Comprehensive Summary of the Journey and Recovery from Masturbation
article4_summary_desc: In the end, recovery from masturbation depends primarily on completely changing your lifestyle, not just a momentary decision. The real beginning is from changing the way of thinking and believing that you can control yourself and get out of this cycle. Over time, reducing stimuli like pornographic content, avoiding isolation and idleness, greatly helps in reducing desire and regaining self-control. Because the less external influences, the more the mind calms down and returns to its natural balance.
article4_summarya_desc: Also, paying attention to a healthy diet, organizing your day, being busy with goals, and practicing supportive habits like Kegel exercises, all of these factors strengthen willpower and help the body and mind stabilize. With continued adherence to these steps, a person begins to notice gradual improvement in mood, energy, and self-confidence, and over time, they can live a more balanced life, away from the habit, with greater focus on their goals and real life.
article4_end_note: If you benefited from this article, follow us on Internet Galaxy to find more tips and articles about overcoming pornography and negative habits, in addition to topics on self-development and lifestyle improvement.
article4_enda_note: See you in a new topic soon, and we wish you a successful journey towards positive change. Peace 👋

article1_title: Smoking and Its Harmful Effects on Health and Society
article1_intro_desc: Smoking is considered one of the most dangerous negative health habits spread around the world. It causes many diseases that affect the life of the individual and society, and despite continuous awareness campaigns, the number of smokers is increasing.
article1_damage1: Increased risk of heart disease and strokes.
article1_damage2: Weakening of the respiratory system and increased chances of lung cancer.
article1_damage3: Deterioration of oral and dental health and appearance of bad breath.
article1_damage4: Negative impact on skin and general appearance due to loss of oxygen.
article1_passive_desc: The harm of smoking does not stop at the smoker only, but extends to those around them, especially children and pregnant women. This is known as passive smoking, which is a major cause of respiratory diseases in children.
article1_quit1: Sincerely decide that you want to stop.
article1_quit2: Seek support from family or friends.
article1_quit4: Replace the bad habit with healthy habits like exercise.
article1_footer_note: 📌 For more information, visit the World Health Organization - Tobacco website

article3_title: The Great Secrets of Lowering the Gaze and Its Hidden Benefits
article3_intro_desc: Lowering the gaze is not just a religious directive, but rather a great door to mental and psychological tranquility. Islam commanded it and the Prophet ﷺ recommended it for a great wisdom that goes beyond the fleeting moment of looking. In this article, we reveal to you the great and hidden secrets that many do not know about lowering the gaze, and its real impact on a person's life.
article3_sec1_title: What happens when you do not lower your gaze?
article3_sec1_desc: When looking at inappropriate images or scenes, these images are stored in the subconscious mind. Satan later uses them to remind the person of them in moments of weakness, causing re-imagination and constant thinking, and may lead to drifting into desires, obsessions, and becoming mentally and emotionally attached to these images.
article3_sec2_title: The Great Benefits of Lowering the Gaze
article3_sec2_li1: Closing the door through which Satan enters.
article3_sec2_li2: Mental and psychological comfort as a result of reducing excessive thinking about forbidden things.
article3_sec2_li3: Protecting brain cells from mental depletion and distraction.
article3_sec2_li4: Increasing concentration in study and work and strengthening memory and comprehension.
article3_sec2_li5: Inner clarity and emotional stability away from the psychological fluctuations resulting from stimulating images.
article3_sec3_title: Lowering the Gaze is for Women Too
article3_sec3_desc: Just as men are required to lower their gaze, women are also required not to become attached to the external appearance of young men or to think excessively about them, because the same mechanism of repetition and satanic whispering applies to both parties. Lowering the gaze protects both the heart and the mind, for both men and women alike.
article3_sec4_title: Why did the Prophet command us to lower the gaze?
article3_sec4_desc: Allah Almighty said: "And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from it" [Al-Hashr: 7]. The Prophet ﷺ did not explain everything in detail because in following his commands lies all good, and lowering the gaze is one of those commands that carry within them great benefits that we only realize through experience.
